changed.title: Find a sparse matrix selector beating the bound that charges each NOT gate separately
changed.statement:
∃ (n m d : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (edge : Bool)
    (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  let nbrR := fun (a : Fin n) => Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin m => G a v = edge)
  let nbrC := fun (c : Fin m) => Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G u c = edge)
  2 ≤ d ∧
  (∀ a, 2 ≤ (nbrR a).card ∧ (nbrR a).card ≤ d) ∧
  (∀ c, 2 ≤ (nbrC c).card ∧ (nbrC c).card ≤ d) ∧
  (∀ a b, a ≠ b → ((nbrR a) ∩ (nbrR b)).card ≤ 1) ∧
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C ∧
  let negs := C.gates.countP (fun g => @decide (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  28 * d * C.size + 78 * d + 2 < (28 * d + 1) * (n + m) + 12 * d * negs

changed.title: Find a bounded nonlinear-depth selector exceeding the two-binomial-sum rank budget
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∃ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let budget := fun (t b : ℕ) =>
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1)) +
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b-1), Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1))
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    represents C ∧ depth (n+m) C ≤ d+1 ∧
    budget (C.gates.countP nonlinear) (2^d) < A.rank

changed.title: Randomized relative approximation of the total number of fitting optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions, with zero on every infeasible input
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let value := fun bs : List Bool => bs.foldr (fun b z => 2*z+b.toNat) 0
∃ (estimate : List Bool → List Bool) (randDegree : Nat), fast estimate ∧

∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  let total := Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f}
  ∀ (b a : Nat), 2 ≤ b → 1 ≤ a →
    let prefixBits := header b ++ header a ++ input
    let ell := (prefixBits.length+2)^randDegree
    let z := fun tape : Fin ell → Bool => value (estimate (prefixBits ++ List.ofFn tape))
    (total = 0 → ∀ tape, z tape = 0) ∧
    2^a * Nat.card {tape : Fin ell → Bool //
      (4*b-4)*total ≤ z tape ∧ z tape ≤ (4*b+4)*total} ≥ (2^a-1)*2^ell
changed.unlocks: Transfers weighted matching approximation to the signed physical fitting problem, with a uniform finite-alphabet randomized machine and exact zero detection.
changed.context: Read the graph representation and return zero for a zero factor. Attach a_i-1 private leaves to vertex i. An unmatched old vertex now has a_i choices, and a matched one has one. Apply the Jerrum-Sinclair approximation scheme for the monomer-dimer partition function, multiply by the factor, amplify with independent medians, and round to units of 1/(4b). Use half the requested tolerance before rounding. A polynomial number of fair bits suffices.
